bearingSource: OSM way 1095381772 long axis 73.9°; +X points ENE to the rounded altar end of the outline, the west tower and the flat west front at −X (vertical drone photo 03, photos 04 and 06)
approximations: Plan scaled on the vertical drone photo 03 and the OSM outline (west tower ≈ 9.2 m square centred 5.7 m from the west front, naos tower 25.7 m from it, altar apse r ≈ 5.6 m, shallow lateral apses r ≈ 2.4 m). Heights estimated from photo proportions (walls ≈ 11 m, roof ≈ 38°, west-tower helm top ≈ 24 m, naos-tower helm top ≈ 26 m; OSM tags 13 / 23 / 25 m are unsourced). Bell-helm profiles, the star base of the naos tower and the roof humps over the lateral apses are idealised; niche registers, window and buttress positions simplified; north side mirrored from the south. Copper shown in the dark brown tone of the photographs. The gate tower of the west precinct wall is added from the OSM outline (way 1095381777: centre 53 m west of the church on its axis, turned ≈ 6° with the wall) and photos 05, 07, 10 and 11: stone body ≈ 8.9 m square and ≈ 13 m high, bell helm ≈ 6 m high in the same dark copper as the church helms, windows and gate surrounds simplified, heights scaled from photo proportions. The precinct wings and the well kiosk (grey roofs of a different finish), the shingle-roofed house and the stone-capped enclosure wall are not modelled.

note.ro: Machetă interpretată după fotografiile cu drona și conturul OSM: planul, turnurile și acoperișurile urmează fotografiile, înălțimile sunt estimate, iar ocnițele, ferestrele și contraforții sunt simplificate; fațada nordică este oglindită după cea sudică. Turnul de poartă din zidul de vest al incintei este inclus: coiful său este din același cupru închis la culoare ca turlele bisericii.
note.hu: Drónfotók és az OSM-körvonal alapján értelmezett makett: az alaprajz, a tornyok és a tetők a fotókat követik, a magasságok becsültek, a fülkesorok, ablakok és támpillérek egyszerűsítettek; az északi homlokzat a déli tükörképe. A kerítőfal nyugati kaputornya is szerepel a maketten: sisakja ugyanabból a sötét rézből készült, mint a templomtornyoké.
note.en: Scale model interpreted from the drone photographs and the OSM outline: plan, towers and roofs follow the photos, heights are estimated, and the niche friezes, windows and buttresses are simplified; the north side mirrors the south. The gate tower in the west precinct wall is included: its helm carries the same dark copper as the church towers.
